title: Files, links, media
intro: Research for Essentials 2.0: Semester → Courses → Files, links, media.

questions.title: Upload + link + embed handled in one place vs. separate features
Organisation model (flat list / folders / sections tied to course structure)
Reuse across courses (central library vs. per-course silo)
Preview and inline playback without leaving the course
Visibility controls (draft / scheduled / per-group) and how they are surfaced
